description: Returns the serving electric utility, EIA-861 retail industrial and commercial rates, large-load tariff schedules, queue delay risks, and demand flexibility options for a utility, project, or location.

company.description: Company, developer, hyperscaler, or utility name, ticker, or organization ID (e.g. 'Microsoft', 'MSFT', 'QTS Data Centers', 'Dominion Energy').

flexible_pct.description: Percentage of load available for demand flexibility or curtailment (e.g. 10).

include_flexibility.description: Include utility demand flexibility opportunity and interruptible rider analysis.

include_interconnection.description: Include utility queue horizon and delivery risk dockets.

include_rto_balance.description: Include regional ISO/RTO capacity balance metrics.

include_tariffs.description: Include EIA-861 retail rates and large-load tariff schedules.

latitude.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. 39.9612).

load_factor.description: Assumed annual load factor between 0.10 and 1.00 (default: 0.85).

load_mw.description: Target peak electrical load in megawatts for rate modeling (default: 100).

location.description: City, county, or location to identify the serving utility (e.g. 'Columbus, OH').

longitude.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. -82.9988).

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

project_id.description: Optional project ID to evaluate its serving utility and tariffs (e.g. 'P003').

project_name.description: Optional project name to resolve serving utility (e.g. 'Hyperion').

query.description: Utility name, project name, or tariff query (e.g. 'AEP Ohio large load tariff').

site.description: Project name, site name, city, county, or canonical ID (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Columbus, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA').

target_mw.description: Alias for target electrical load in megawatts (e.g. 200).

utility_id.description: EIA utility ID or AIxEnergy utility slug (e.g. 'dominion-energy-virginia').

utility_name.description: Electric utility name (e.g. 'Dominion Energy Virginia', 'AEP Ohio', 'Oncor', 'Entergy Louisiana').

name: evaluate_utility_and_tariffs

next_useful_tools.description: Suggested follow-up MCP tools relevant to this result.

status.description: Execution status (OK, SUCCESS, RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY, NOT_FOUND, ERROR).

using_project.description: Banner confirming the resolved project name, city, state, and canonical ID when a project was matched.

title: Evaluate Utility Rates and Tariffs
